thread:
olivia (support): @here ZenPay reporting production failures when using JSON mode. ~5% of generation responses fail JSON parse with 'Invalid JSON: trailing comma at position 342'. Customer impact: checkout webhook retries failing.

olivia (support): sample model output from their logs: 
```
{"order_id": "ZP-44321", "items": [{"sku":"ABC123","qty":2,}, {"sku":"X99","qty":1,}], "total": 123.45}
```

ingest-bot: automated alert: zenpay-prod - json_parse_errors = 47 in last 10m (baseline 0).

kevin (cs): Customer says error started after last week's model update; they need a short-term workaround and an ETA for a fix. They are blocking a live A/B test.

tess (eng): Can you paste the exact request + model_id + prompt used? Need to reproduce locally. Is the output coming directly from the model or via a transform hook?

olivia (support): Repro steps I have: 1) POST /v1/generate {model: "open-variant-v2", mode: "json" , prompt: <their prompt>} 2) parse fails at our structured parser. Attached request body (sanitized) and a couple more responses show trailing commas and sometimes single quotes around keys.

olivia (support): quick logs: 
```
2026-03-17T09:12:03Z ERROR parser: invalid JSON at offset 342: unexpected token ','
request_id=req_8a3c customer=zenpay route=/v1/generate
```

raj (sre): Reasonable hypothesis: model stochasticity -> produces malformed JSON. We should provide two things: 1) immediate mitigation for customer (support-side), 2) engineering fix for tolerant parsing and guardrails.

kevin (cs): For customer comms: can we offer a temporary setting they can flip? They asked for a toggle rather than code changes on their side.

olivia (support): Proposed short-term options I gave them: 1) pre-parse with a tolerant JSON5-style parser on their side (we provided a small regex snippet), 2) have us enable 'lenient_structured_parsing' on their tenant for 72h while eng investigates. They prefer option 2.

olivia (support): regex we suggested to customer (quick hack): `s/,(\s*[}\]])/\1/g` to strip trailing commas before json.loads. Not ideal but stops failures immediately.

tess (eng): We should avoid regex fixes in platform since it can mask real schema errors. Short-term we can add a tenant-scoped flag to our parser that runs a tolerant pass (strip trailing commas, convert single quotes to double) and log cases we corrected. That gives CS time. I'll scope this as a hotfix.

raj (sre): SLA/priority? Customer on paid Dedicated plan, blocking live flow. Recommend P1. Support SLA: initial response already done, temporary mitigation offered. Engineering target: hotfix to enable lenient parsing per-tenant within 24 hours, full parser hardening within 72 hours.

kevin (cs): I'll send the following to customer now: "We can enable a temporary lenient-JSON parsing toggle on your account within the hour — it will stop the parse failures while we push a durable fix. This is scoped as a high-priority engineering change and we expect a permanent fix within 72 hours. Please confirm if you want us to enable the toggle."

olivia (support): Customer confirmed — please enable lenient parsing for tenant zenpay-prod.

raj (sre): @tess taking ownership for the platform hotfix. Next steps for eng: 
- create tenant flag (lenient_structured_parsing) behind feature flag.
- implement tolerant cleanup: strip trailing commas, normalize quotes, and run JSON.parse; emit telemetry of corrected responses.
- add a provenance header in responses when cleanup occurred.
- add unit tests + canary on staging then prod.

tess (eng): Ack. I'll open ENG-3127 and aim for rollout in three deploys: staging canary (2h), gradual prod (6h), global enable for tenant (within 24h). If we hit unexpected edge cases, rollback and fall back to customer-side regex.

olivia (support): Draft customer message ready, confirming toggle enable.

kevin (cs): Sent to customer, they replied: "Please enable now — the regex patch is risky on our side."

raj (sre): I've patched the tenant config to enable lenient parsing for zenpay-prod. Validation: making a few test requests — parser now accepts the sample with trailing commas and returns structured payload + header `x-structured-parse: corrected`.

olivia (support): Passed to customer for quick verification. Customer confirms success: "checkout retries stopped" and error rate dropped to 0.7% in the last 10m. :tada:

tess (eng): Following up: will keep ENG-3127 open for the full fix. We'll include a telemetry dashboard for corrected parses and escalate if corrected > 1% of responses (to avoid silent data corruption).

kevin (cs): Closing loop in ticket: note workaround enabled, ETA for permanent fix 72h, P1 escalation active.

olivia (support): Marking thread resolved from support side. If eng needs more logs, add to ENG-3127.

tess (eng): Thanks everyone. I'll post updates in ENG-3127 and ping #eng-oncall if we see regression after rollout.
